alpha_vector._schema_note: alpha_vector here is asset-level rotation expected return placeholder. Actual time-varying weights at stage_artifacts/WT_WT-S20260504_009/alpha_scores.parquet (sig_date × ticker × weight × signal_value). Asset-level allocation NOT stock-level alpha — request.json hard_constraints.weight_bounds [0,0.20] does not directly apply to ETF rotation universe (n=9 ETFs). factor_specs.formula: signal_i,t = trailing 12m return ETF_i (PIT t-1 lagged inputs); long-only filter (signal_i > 0); vol-scaled w_i ∝ target_vol/vol_6m_i; renormalize Σw_i = 1 over positive set; if no positive signals → 100% TIGER_KIS_SHORT_TERM (cash equivalent)
factor_specs.lag_rule: all ETF returns + vols + macros at t-1 (PIT C2/C5/C9 compliant)
